title: Directive 2002/58/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 12 July 2002 concerning the processing of personal data and the protection of privacy in the electronic communications sector (Directive on privacy and electronic communications), consolidated version of 19.12.2009, which includes the amendments made by Directive 2006/24/EC and Directive 2009/136/EC
fetch: HTTP GET with Accept: application/xhtml+xml and Accept-Language: eng; the resource answered 303 to the cellar URL above, which answered 200
role: reading aid: the Publications Office consolidated version, which says of itself that it is meant purely as a documentation tool and has no legal effect; the Official Journal text is authentic. Recitals are not part of it. The `▼B`, `▼M1` and `▼M2` markers of the consolidated version are kept in the text file, one per line.
in_force: The latest consolidated version. A SPARQL query to https://publications.europa.eu/webapi/rdf/sparql on 2026-11-17 listed two consolidated versions of the Directive (CELEX 02002L0058-20060503 and 02002L0058-20091219) and two acts that amend it (Directive 2006/24/EC, CELEX 32006L0024, and Directive 2009/136/EC, CELEX 32009L0136). The same query lists Directive (EU) 2018/1972 (CELEX 32018L1972) as repealing Directive 2002/21/EC, to which Art 2 of the consolidated text still refers for definitions; no consolidation was made after that act.
corrigenda: Four corrigenda are recorded on the Directive (CELEX 32002L0058R(01) to R(04)); the same query lists them in Slovak, Czech, Bulgarian and Latvian only, so none changes the English text.
sha256_of: the XHTML original as fetched (68661 bytes); not re-deposited here (licence undetermined, as for the other XHTML originals of the EU subjects)
rendered_by: xhtml_to_text.py in this folder (standard library only; run as python3 -I xhtml_to_text.py IN.xhtml OUT.txt): one block per line, a list label joined to its text, a footnote reference as [^N], an exponent as ^N, table rows as | a | b |, amendment markers as their own lines

directive_2006_24_declared_void.what: Whether the Publications Office data records that the Court of Justice declared Directive 2006/24/EC (the data retention Directive, referred to in Art 15(1a)) void. Checked because Art 15(1a) of the consolidated text still refers to that Directive and the file says nothing of the judgment.
directive_2006_24_declared_void.result: The data records the judgment with CELEX 62012CJ0293, dated 2014-04-08, under the property cdm:case-law_declares_void_by_preliminary_ruling_resource_legal, with Directive 2006/24/EC (CELEX 32006L0024) as its object. It holds the notices of cases C-293/12 (CELEX 62012CN0293) and C-594/12 (CELEX 62012CN0594), each under cdm:case-law_requests_interpretation_resource_legal of that Directive. A query for judgment records under 62012CJ0293 and 62012CJ0594 returned only 62012CJ0293. The data was not read for what the judgment decides, so the effect on Art 15(1a) is not decided here.

judgment_relation.sparql: PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#> SELECT DISTINCT ?celex ?p ?directive ?date WHERE { ?j cdm:resource_legal_id_celex ?celex . ?j ?p ?d . ?d cdm:resource_legal_id_celex ?directive . FILTER(STR(?celex) = "62012CJ0293" && STR(?directive) = "32006L0024" && CONTAINS(STR(?p), "declares_void")) OPTIONAL { ?j cdm:work_date_document ?date } }

case_notices.sparql: PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#> SELECT DISTINCT ?celex ?p ?directive WHERE { ?j cdm:resource_legal_id_celex ?celex . ?j ?p ?d . ?d cdm:resource_legal_id_celex ?directive . FILTER((STR(?celex) = "62012CN0293" || STR(?celex) = "62012CN0594") && STR(?directive) = "32006L0024") }

judgment_records.sparql: PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#> SELECT DISTINCT ?celex WHERE { ?j cdm:resource_legal_id_celex ?celex . FILTER(STR(?celex) = "62012CJ0293" || STR(?celex) = "62012CJ0594") }
